controls.title: Add a reminder
controls.description: Starts a new reminder for the reminders page. Home hub then asks when it is due.

controls.title: Check reminders
controls.description: Reads out the unfinished reminders that are due today, along with any that are overdue. Name a day, a weekend or a week, such as tomorrow or this week, to hear what is due then instead.

controls.title: Tick off a reminder
controls.description: Marks a reminder as done. You don't need its exact title: the gist is enough.

controls.title: Move a reminder
controls.description: Changes when a reminder is due. Home hub then asks for the new due time.

controls.title: Delete a reminder
controls.description: Deletes a reminder for good. Home hub says which one it found and asks before deleting it, so answer yes or no.

controls.title: Give a due time
controls.description: Sets the due time of the reminder you are adding or moving. A day by itself means 9 in the morning, and a time by itself means the next time the clock shows it.

controls.title: Skip the due time
controls.description: Leaves the reminder you are adding or moving without a due time. Saying "no" does the same.

controls.title: Start a saved timer
controls.description: Loads one of the presets saved on the ADHD timer page and starts it on every screen.

controls.title: Start the timer
controls.description: Starts the timer with whatever plan the ADHD timer page is showing. If it is already running, it starts again from now.

controls.title: Stop the timer
controls.description: Stops the timer on every screen and keeps its plan.

controls.title: Check the timer
controls.description: Says which task the timer is on and how long is left for it, what comes next, and when you need to be ready. If the timer isn't running, it says whether it is stopped or has finished.

controls.title: Hear the saved timers
controls.description: Reads out the names of the presets saved on the ADHD timer page.

controls.title: Ask for a change to the site
controls.description: Passes your request to Claude, as if you had typed it on the site editor page. The change still has to be looked at and confirmed on that page.

controls.title: Check on a change
controls.description: Says whether Claude is still working, or whether the change is ready to look at.
